thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple PagerDuty pages fired for `inference-api-us` (P1). Event group: alert-fanout-20260321. Auto-grouping created 3 incidents but paging duplicated across regions.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: new alert created (INC-20260321-88), routed to oncall. Multiple duplicate alerts detected (count=24).

dalia: I just got three separate calls in a row. Looks like PD integration didn't dedupe by dedup_key change. Oncall here — pausing escalation.

samir: Confirming: dedupe-key changed in last deploy, incident-bot grouping window is 10s, but alerts had different keys (region tag). Paging fanout = true so every region created a page.

dalia: Can someone suppress all pages for `inference-api-us` quickly? This is creating a paging storm.

henry: Running quick stop-gap: `/incident-bot silence --service inference-api-us --scope all --duration 30m --reason "paging storm - emergency silence"`

incident-bot: Silence created: inference-api-us scope=all duration=30m by henry. All active pages will be silenced; ongoing alerts still recorded.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: silenced on-call routing for `inference-api-us`. Escalations paused.

samir: Root cause hypothesis: recent alert rule refactor added `region` to dedupe key. Previously we deduped on `service+alertname`. New key = `service+alertname+region` causing multi-region duplicates.

dalia: Ouch. That explains the fanout. We need to adjust grouping logic and reprocess the 20 pending alerts as a single incident.

henry: Quick mitigation: revert alert rule to remove region from dedupe key. Command patch:```yaml
- alert: High5xxRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"} [1m])>0) by (service,region)
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "5xx spike"
```
Change to:```yaml
  by (service)
```

sophie: I'll apply the patch to alertmanager config and reload. `kubectl -n observability apply -f alertmanager-patch.yaml && kubectl -n observability rollout restart deployment/alertmanager`

incident-bot: Alertmanager reload detected. Grouping key updated. Re-evaluating active alerts.

samir: After reload, Alertmanager consolidated alerts into single group. Pending PD pages reduced from 24 -> 1.

dalia: Great. Now we need to confirm there was no customer impact besides noise. Any actual error trend?

henry: Checking metrics: small latency blip in us-west at 10:05 UTC, p95 +40ms, error rate steady. Logs show retries but no 5xx flood.

sophie: No evidence of request failures. Customers shouldn't have seen errors. This looks like alerting misconfiguration rather than runtime failure.

dalia: Ok — status: paging storm mitigated. Silence will expire in 30m unless we remove it earlier. Please don't escalate while we finish cleanup.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: silence active. New pages suppressed.

samir: Follow-ups I'm creating:
- move `region` to a separate label, do not include in dedupe key (owners: obs-team)
- add unit test for alert grouping behavior in CI (owners: obs-team)
- provide a runbook step for emergency `incident-bot silence --scope all` (owners: oncall)

dalia: Handoff notes for next oncall (henry will take over in 20m):
- incident: alert-fanout-20260321 (mitigated)
- cause: alertmanager dedupe key change (region included)
- mitigation: created a 30m silence, patched alertmanager grouping key, consolidated pages
- customer impact: none identified (no 5xx surge), only oncall noise.

dalia: Henry, I'll stay around for 10m to confirm silence expiry handling. If it expires early, reapply with shorter window.

henry: Ack. I'll monitor and follow up with a small changelog PR to revert the dedupe-key commit and include test.

incident-bot: Silence will auto-expire at 1820001799 (30m). Auto-grouping threshold unchanged: 10s window.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: silence removal scheduled; manual removal possible via `/incident-bot unsilence inference-api-us`

sophie: Quick note — I also pushed a minor improvement to incident-bot to log `suppression_origin` so we can trace who created silences during storms. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/obs/incident-bot/pull/194

dalia: Thanks team. Closing this thread after handoff. If you get a pager while I'm still available, @dalia. Otherwise Henry will own the follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
